description: This Dart source file defines the main user interface and presentation layer for a Flutter app featuring the React Agent. It includes the main screen widget, state management for UI elements, settings sheet, and debugging overlay, handling user interactions like input, settings, and debug toggling.

classes.name: ReactAgentScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the primary screen of the React Agent app, managing UI state, rendering header, steps, input, and debug overlay.

classes.name: _SettingsResult
classes.description: A primitive class encapsulating the result of the settings modal, primarily conveying a status message.

classes.name: _ReactAgentScreenState
classes.description: State class managing UI state, interactions, and lifecycle for ReactAgentScreen.

classes.name: _SettingsSheet
classes.description: A modal bottom sheet widget for user to input or clear API keys/settings.

classes.name: _SettingsSheetState
classes.description: State class handling the logic and UI of the settings sheet, including saving and clearing API keys.

classes.name: _DebugOverlayPanel
classes.description: Overlay widget displaying debug information like internal state variables and step list.

classes.name: _DebugChip
classes.description: UI component for displaying individual debug key-value pairs.

classes.name: _PrimaryActionButton
classes.description: Decorated button styled for primary actions with gradient and progress indicator.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers and sets up listeners; loads stored API key and configures the controller.

methods.name: _onChanged
methods.description: Handles UI updates when the controller reports a change, including auto-scrolling and input reset.

methods.name: _toggleDebugPanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the debug overlay panel.

methods.name: _openSettingsSheet
methods.description: Displays the settings sheet modal; captures result to show snack messages.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Checks for snackbar messages to display after state changes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main UI, including header, steps, input field, and debug overlay if enabled.

methods.name: _buildHeader
methods.description: Constructs the header section of the UI with app title, mode indicator, settings, input, and actions.

methods.name: _buildSteps
methods.description: Builds the list of step cards representing the agent's reasoning steps.

methods.name: _buildEmpty
methods.description: Builds the placeholder UI when no steps are present, prompting user input.
